identities: official namespace IDs only; unknown remains null, never name-only joins
time: All source/identity observations and race off must precede the requested cutoff; exclude target race; no invented availability
pair: rider-change index difference at the same cutoff
adjustment: Joint ridge decomposition: centred observed field performance = horse component + jockey component + race offset. Only complete fields with all horse/jockey IDs enter adjustment.
ties: Pairwise finishing percentile gives equal ranks equal credit; top-k share allocates tied boundary positions fractionally
score_scale: clip(50+100*component,0,100); 50 is the zero component, not a 50% chance
support: Display sample counts and n/(n+penalty) separately; this support is not probability of correctness
unknown: No observed history or no eligible adjustment rows => null index with zero support; never report average as observed ability
limitations: Observational estimates depend on connected horse-rider assignments and regularization; not a causal or complete class/opponent-strength separation; sparse condition stats remain sparse
prediction_integration: Attach the separate indices to rank_forecast output; existing forecast probabilities unchanged until a separately trained, frozen comparison supports the new features
forbidden: No target outcomes/odds/payouts in current-card indices; no automatic live promotion
